import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import urllib.request
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from pathlib import Path
from makemarket.provenance import receipt,file_sha256

p=Path('results/training/kaggle_original_final_resume.json');r=json.loads(p.read_text())
r.update(status='failed_missing_rejected_input_source',actual_kernel='nicolascoquelet/makemarketbench-frozen-grpo-final-resume',actual_kernel_id=141578574,
         terminal_status='KernelWorkerStatus.ERROR',observed_terminal_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
         diagnosis='Kaggle rejects the cancelled parent kernel as an input source. The title also resolved to a different new slug. Runtime assertion finds zero mounted adapters; no inference was performed.')
log=Path('runs/kaggle_original_eval_resume_failure/makemarketbench-frozen-grpo-final-resume.log')
records=json.loads(log.read_text())
r['last_log_seconds']=max(x['time'] for x in records)
r['failure_log_sha256']=file_sha256(log)
Path('results/kaggle/original-resume-failure-v1').mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
shutil.copyfile(log,'results/kaggle/original-resume-failure-v1/full.log')
p.write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
ledger_path=Path('results/training/kaggle_budget.json');ledger=json.loads(ledger_path.read_text())
ledger['sessions'].append({'kernel':r['actual_kernel'],'version':1,'accelerator':'T4 x2 requested','start':None,'end':None,
 'hours':r['last_log_seconds']/3600,'hours_basis':'Last downloaded log timestamp only, not exact billing duration.',
 'submitted_at':r['submitted_at'],'purpose':'Attempted continuation; failed because cancelled parent input was rejected.',
 'private':True,'status':r['status'],'receipt':str(p)})
ledger_path.write_text(json.dumps(ledger,indent=2)+'\n')
folder=Path('runs/kaggle_original_adapter_dataset');folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
sources={
 'adapter_model.safetensors':Path('runs/kaggle_original_adapter/lora_adapter/adapter_model.safetensors'),
 'adapter_config.json':Path('runs/kaggle_original_output/lora_adapter/adapter_config.json'),
 'trainer_state.json':Path('runs/kaggle_original_output/grpo/checkpoint-300/trainer_state.json'),
 'dice_grpo.jsonl':Path('runs/kaggle_original_output/results/raw/dice/qwen3.5-4b-grpo.jsonl'),
 'bayes_dice.jsonl':Path('runs/kaggle_original_output/results/raw/dice/bayes.jsonl'),
 'bayes_cards.jsonl':Path('runs/kaggle_original_output/results/raw/cards/bayes.jsonl')}
for name,source in sources.items():shutil.copyfile(source,folder/name)
license_url='https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B/resolve/851bf6e806efd8d0a36b00ddf55e13ccb7b8cd0a/LICENSE'
license_bytes=urllib.request.urlopen(license_url).read()
assert b'Apache License' in license_bytes
(folder/'LICENSE.txt').write_bytes(license_bytes)
(folder/'NOTICE.txt').write_text('LoRA derivative of Qwen3.5-4B, Qwen Team, Alibaba Cloud.\nUnsloth NF4 conversion; original model revision 3764fa359b9082ea5a1e4a5e3ac3aaf6e9671636.\nModifications by Nicolas Coquelet: 150 SFT and 300 exact-EV GRPO updates on synthetic MakeMarketBench data.\nOnly adapter weights are included. Synthetic episode records are MIT, copyright Nicolas Coquelet.\n')
shutil.copyfile('LICENSE',folder/'SYNTHETIC_DATA_LICENSE.txt')
record={'provenance':receipt({'purpose':'privately preserve original final GRPO adapter and partial frozen cohorts'},'3764fa359b9082ea5a1e4a5e3ac3aaf6e9671636'),
 'source_kernel':'nicolascoquelet/makemarketbench-grpo-qwen3','source_version':1,
 'source_completion':'results/training/kaggle_original_completion.json',
 'adapter_download_command':['kaggle','kernels','output','nicolascoquelet/makemarketbench-grpo-qwen3','-p','runs/kaggle_original_adapter','--file-pattern','^lora_adapter/adapter_model.safetensors$'],
 'file_sha256':{name:file_sha256(folder/name) for name in sources},'upstream_license_url':license_url,'upstream_license_sha256':hashlib.sha256(license_bytes).hexdigest(),
 'calculation_source':Path(__file__).read_text()}
(folder/'original_grpo_receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
meta={'title':'MakeMarketBench original GRPO checkpoint','id':'nicolascoquelet/makemarketbench-original-grpo-checkpoint',
 'licenses':[{'name':'apache-2.0'}],'isPrivate':True,
 'description':'Private Qwen3.5-4B LoRA adapter by Nicolas Coquelet: 150 SFT and 300 GRPO updates. Apache-2.0 model derivative; MIT synthetic episodes carry a separate licence. Base weights are not included. Exact hashes and source receipt included.'}
(folder/'dataset-metadata.json').write_text(json.dumps(meta,indent=2)+'\n')
env=os.environ.copy();env['KAGGLE_CONFIG_DIR']=str(Path('runs/kaggle_oauth_config').resolve())
for name in ['KAGGLE_KEY','KAGGLE_API_TOKEN','KAGGLE_TOKEN_FILE']:env.pop(name,None)
command=['kaggle','datasets','create','-p',str(folder),'--quiet']
value=subprocess.run(command,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True)
record.update(dataset=meta['id'],command=command,create={'exit_code':value.returncode,'output':value.stdout+value.stderr},status='created' if value.returncode==0 else 'failed')
Path('results/training/kaggle_original_adapter_dataset.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
print(record['create'])
assert value.returncode==0
